1 Communications & Public Affairs Manager (all genders) Key Responsibilities

Communications Hub & Single Source of Truth

 * Serve as the single coordination point through whom all communications decisions, inputs, and outputs flow
 * Build and own zerothird's AI-supported knowledge base: approved messaging, narratives, assets, and institutional knowledge - always current, always accessible
 * Enforce narrative consistency across every output and every channel
 * Turn leadership strategy into a concrete, sequenced operational plan

Agency Interface & Project Management

 * Own the relationship with our external communications and public affairs consultancy: brief, review, push back, and deliver
 * Drive internal sign-off processes; track milestones and open items across all active projects
 * Escalate decisions to management fast, with context and a clear recommendation

Content Creation

 * Continuously mine for content: extract proof points, developments, and stories from R&D, Sales, Management, and external sources and turn them into communications material before the moment passes
 * Review and quality-check for factual accuracy, brand consistency, and tone before sign-off
 * Maintain a structured content calendar aligned with the broader campaign plan

Channel Management

 * Own and operate zerothird's communications channels: website, LinkedIn, newsletters, and owned event formats
 * Manage the content lifecycle from briefing through publication; implement targeting concepts
 * Drive SEO and digital visibility - ensure zerothird is findable where it matters

Corporate Identity

 * Be the internal guardian of zerothird's corporate identity across all formats and channels
 * Work with external design resources to enforce brand standards

Public & Governmental Affairs

 * Act as the operational counterpart to the external consultancy's public affairs leads: schedule meetings with political stakeholders, prepare briefing materials, follow up on engagement activities
 * Monitor relevant regulatory and policy developments and flag them internally

Campaign Execution

 * Coordinate the production of campaign assets as the internal project owner on zerothird's side
 * Manage timelines, external inputs, and internal review cycles for each campaign element
 * Track and report KPIs in a structured format

Your Profile

 * Several years of relevant experience in communications, public affairs, or agency account management
 * Fluent in German and English - written and spoken, at the highest professional level. Additional languages a plus
 * Strong written output: you can draft press releases, LinkedIn posts, and political briefings in the same week - all without heavy revision
 * Sharp eye for visual quality and corporate identity - you notice when something is off and you know how to fix it
 * Proven experience managing external agencies - briefing well, pushing back constructively, holding partners accountable
 * AI-native working style - you use AI tools to produce faster, structure better, and maintain the knowledge base that keeps this operation running
 * Structured, proactive, and diplomatically assertive - comfortable managing upwards and sideways
 * Familiarity with deep tech, cybersecurity, or policy-adjacent sectors is an advantage; start-up or scale-up experience is a strong plus

What We Offer

 * A front-row seat at one of Europe's most consequential deep-tech scale-ups
 * The opportunity to build zerothird's communications function from the ground up - with the backing of world-class agency partners
 * Direct collaboration with founders and senior leadership
 * Vienna-based, with travel across Europe as required

The minimum gross salary for this position is €3.586,73 per month (based on full-time employment) in accordance with the applicable collective agreement. However, there is a willingness to offer a higher salary depending on experience and qualifications.

jobs.description:
We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Technical Customer Success Manager - Italian Market (m/f/d) Your Role

As Technical Customer Success Manager for the Italian market, you are the primary point of contact for your customer cohort (of SMBs) once they've signed. You own their success, satisfaction, and retention end to end.

You actively build relationships, identify value drivers, and ensure every customer gets the most out of fonio. You'll spend most of your time in calls and meetings with customers and implementing or improving their setups.

What to expect

 * Own a portfolio of Italian SMB customers across their full lifecycle

 * Build relationships, surface value, and find new use cases for AI agents to keep customers engaged

 * Support customers in setting up their AI assistant; implement workflows for medium complex cases and coordinate with developers for advanced setups

 * Run check-ins and proactive calls based on usage signals (low engagement, expansion opportunities, setup friction)

 * Work with a ready-made pipeline and clear playbooks, with room to test your own initiatives

 * Maximize the value generated from each customer in your portfolio

 * Spot churn risks early and act on them

 * Manage your activity autonomously in HubSpot

Who We're Looking For

 * 2-5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, Forward Deployment Engineer or a technical client-facing SaaS/B2B role

 * Ideally a strong technical understanding - comfortable understanding API documentation and error logs to troubleshoot customer setup issues independently

 ** Experience with tools like n8n, make.com, codex or similar

 * An affinity for tech / AI products is a real plus

 * C2 Italian, strong English

 * Structured, autonomous, results-driven

 * You build trust easily with customers, by phone or video

 * You take initiative, test, iterate, and don't wait to be told what to do

 * Comfortable with CRM (ideally HubSpot) and data-driven workflows

 * Willing to relocate to Vienna for 1-2 months initially

 

What We Offer

 * €60,000-80,000 OTE

 * Equity: you help build it, you should own a piece of it

 * Equipment of your choice

 * A product that sells itself and that customers love (4.5 stars on Trustpilot, Google, and OMR)

 * Regular team offsites

 * Office in Vienna or Barcelona, onsite, in an ambitious team that wants to do the most exciting work of their careers

 

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 30 min getting to know the country's Go-to-Market manager

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders
